name: The Concord Glass Forks
summary: Tuning-forks of woven glass from the Concord's colleges, used in every circle-test on Aurelith. Struck inside a warded circle, the fork sounds a note that living Glimmer answers — a shimmer around anyone carrying the echo. There are perhaps sixty forks left; each is numbered, tracked, and irreplaceable. The glass was made before the Sundering and no furnace since can work it.
origin: Concord of Weavers — college workshops, pre-1,201 CoW
current_whereabouts: Distributed to warden-circles across the realms; the reserve rests in the archive-quarter.
properties: The note is felt in the teeth before it is heard
A Glimmerborn's answering shimmer intensifies with proximity to their talent — wardens claim they can rank suspects by degree of shine
Struck outside a warded circle, the fork answers everything faintly: wards, relics, old wounds in the world
keepers: Censer wardens; quota pressure means forks are struck more often than ever, and wear is real — three have cracked in the last decade.
value_or_danger: Each fork is worth an army to the Mile and a heresy trial to whoever loses one.
adventure_hooks: A cracked fork is sold in the Mile; its false-positive readings could mark half a district as Glimmerborn.
Players must steal a fork to prove a circle-test fraud — the same fork that condemned their client.
A fork rings itself at night in the evidence-vault, pointing steadily east.

rarity.note: ~60 survive as a class; each numbered, none replaceable.
